trigger: The Remnant picket at the Glendale bridge over the frozen Truckee.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The Truckee is frozen solid, edge to edge. A searchlight on the bridge ahead sweeps the ice. Kessler's picket.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Thirty people behind you. Kids. Sleds. The searchlight crosses the ice every forty seconds.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: East pier. The searchlight's motor hangs every third pass. I installed it. Nine seconds of dark. Go on my mark.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Nine seconds at a time, thirty people cross under the bridge. Nobody coughs. Nobody cries. A miracle of cold.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No way under without being seen.

nodes.speaker: ironwood_soldier
nodes.text: Ruiz's ID? ...She's alive? Go. Go before the lieutenant wakes up. I didn't see you.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Muzzle flash on the ice. The searchlight dies. So do two of them. The column runs.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Three hours in the whiteout. When it's thick enough, you cross. Two people don't get up from the snow.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Past the bridge, the river bends south toward Steamboat Creek. The blizzard closes behind you.
